title: HOW DOES AI FIND YOUR WEBSITE?
description:
Growthino is a Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) agency that helps startups become visible, cited, and recommended in AI answers across platforms, including ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Claude, and Gemini. Founded by Alice Chazelas and Mohamed Abdelkader.

On this channel, we’ll share practical strategies for GEO, entity modeling, AI-ready content architecture, schema strategy, citation authority building, and AI search visibility.
